_note: Voices the person picked on 2026-11-11. Keep new lines on the same model, voice and settings so they match.

narrator.style_instructions: Voice: the narrator of a survival horror game. A low, grave, intimate male voice, very close to the microphone, slow and deliberate, almost confiding a terrible secret. Let the last words drop to a near-whisper.
narrator.notes: Write RaGoon as 'Rah-goon' in the text or Gemini may say a different city name.

tallyman.notes: Style B (wet, labored respirator). Run speech through mask_filter. Never put breathing under speech: stalker.gd fades the breath loop (assets/audio/sfx/stalker_breath.ogg, from ElevenLabs SFX v2) out while he talks.
